summary: Pull requests run only the app unit tests whose imports reach a changed file; merge groups and manual runs still run every test file.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CI-only change to which unit tests a pull request runs; no application, API or user-visible behavior change.

recovery.detail: Reverting runs every app unit test on pull requests again; nothing to recover.
